verdict.detail: The same year as the first issue (US, RS 6420, 1970).

notes.text:
Released on silver-on-black 'Straight' label unique to Denmark. First cat# on label, 2nd on sleeve.

On labels: At 3 o'clock - "Stereo", cat# and both label sides state 'A' + 'B' as well as 'Side 1' and 'Side 2'. At 9 o'clock - All rights reserved / Made In Denmark / NCB / 1970.

Comes with a laminated imported German stock sleeve with a square "Straight" sticker in bottom right corner, almost certainly covering the printed "Straight" logo (ie. 'Straight' in a bubble above a 'smoking' cigarette). The cat# on back cover (top right) is followed by a squared D. A 'Decals' poem and a painting by Van Vliet are printed on back cover.

All track timings printed on the labels are different to the timings printed on the back cover. Also, there are a couple of spelling errors on track titles [ie. "I Love You, You Big Dummy" becomes "Love You, You Big Dummy" and "Flash Gordon's Ape" becomes "Flack Gordon's Ape"].
